statement: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed defeats Republican Mike Rogers in the Michigan US Senate election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: True if the Associated Press calls the 2026-11-03 Michigan US Senate race for El-Sayed by 2026-11-13. False if it calls the race for Rogers or has made no call.
failure_condition: El-Sayed has not been called the winner of the Michigan Senate race by the Associated Press at the deadline.

statement: Senators in the Democratic caucus, including independents who caucus with Democrats, hold at least 51 seats in the US Senate between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-08.
resolution: True if the official Senate.gov party division page shows at least 51 Democrats plus caucusing independents on any day between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-08. Otherwise false.
failure_condition: The Democratic caucus holds 50 or fewer Senate seats throughout 2027-01-03 to 2027-01-08.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range by 25 basis points to 4.00-4.25 percent at its meeting concluding 2026-12-09.
resolution: True if FRED series DFEDTARU shows 4.25 percent for 2026-12-10. Reference: upper bound 4.00 percent on the packet date. Otherwise false.
failure_condition: The target range upper bound in effect on 2026-12-10 is not 4.25 percent.

statement: ICE Brent front-month futures settle at or above 120.00 dollars on at least one trading day between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: True if an ICE Brent front-month daily settlement is at or above 120.00 between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-18. Reference: 105.99 on the packet date. Otherwise false.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month daily settlement between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-18 is below 120.00 dollars.

statement: The S&P 500 closes at or above 7,800 on 2026-12-31.
resolution: True if FRED series SP500 shows a 2026-12-31 close at or above 7,800. Reference: 7,631.17 on the packet date. Otherwise false.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 official close on 2026-12-31 is below 7,800.

statement: US forces conduct at least one kinetic strike on a target on Iranian land territory between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: True if CENTCOM or the Pentagon acknowledges a US strike on Iranian land territory occurring between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-11, and both Reuters and AP report it. Otherwise false.
failure_condition: No US strike on Iranian land territory occurs between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-11.

statement: US and Iranian government delegations meet in the same city for a round of talks, direct or mediated, between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: True if both governments confirm such a round took place between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-11, as reported by Reuters or AP. Talks with mediators alone, without both delegations present, do not count.
failure_condition: US and Iranian delegations do not both attend a confirmed round of talks in one city between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-11.

statement: CISA adds GitLab vulnerability CVE-2026-110264 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-11-03 and 2026-12-04.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog carries CVE-2026-110264 with a date-added value between 2026-11-03 and 2026-12-04. Otherwise false.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-110264 lacks a CISA KEV date-added value between 2026-11-03 and 2026-12-04.

statement: A national government formally attributes the European supermarket refrigeration cyberattacks to a named state or named threat group between 2026-11-03 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: True if a national government, prosecutor or cyber agency publicly names a responsible state or group between 2026-11-03 and 2027-01-29, as reported by Reuters or AP. Anonymous sourcing and private-sector attribution do not count.
failure_condition: No national government body publicly names a responsible state or group between 2026-11-03 and 2027-01-29.

statement: The NTSB publishes a preliminary report on the South Florida jet crash that killed nine people between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-04.
resolution: True if the NTSB CAROL database or NTSB website shows a preliminary report for this crash published between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-04. Otherwise false.
failure_condition: The NTSB has not published a preliminary report on this crash by 2026-12-04.
